newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Sasib 1996 net profits fall.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Sasib 1996 net profits fall.

text.p: Italian engineering group Sasib, controlled by Carlo De Benedetti's CIR industrial holding group, on Friday reported a fall in 1996 consolidated net profits to 40.4 billion lire from 1995's 52.5 billion.

The company also announced in a statement that its 1996 dividends for its ordinary shares and privilege shares would be 200 lire per share, and for savings shares 220 lire, all payouts unchanged from 1995.

The group said its 1996 annual turnover rose 7.4 percent to 1.589 trillion lire, with operating profits rising 12.1 percent to 58.6 billion lire but pretax profits slipping 15.1 percent to 69.6 billion lire after a restructuring charge of 10.8 billion.
